summary: Coach Watch Health Badge feature fully tested. All features working correctly - Journey page loads with Coach Panel in sidebar, 'Staff Stable' (green) badge shows when no alerts, 'Staff Change' (amber) badge shows with alert detail box when alerts exist, Coach Panel displays coaches with name/role/email/phone, Add Coach button opens form correctly, and backend API returns alert data.

minor.issue: Returns 403 for Pro tier user - requires Premium subscription
minor.note: This is EXPECTED behavior per code design. The individual school alert API (/api/ai/coach-watch/alert/{university_name}) works for all users and is used by the Journey page badge.

issues: Console warning about span child in select/option - hydration issue in dev mode only, not visible to users

critical_code_review_comments: Coach Watch badge correctly shows green 'Staff Stable' when no alerts exist for the school (coachWatchAlert is null/undefined)
Coach Watch badge correctly shows amber 'Staff Change' when coachWatchAlert exists for the school
Alert detail box correctly displays alert_type mapping (new_coach, coach_departure, staff_change), summary text, and detection date
GET /api/ai/coach-watch/alert/{university_name} endpoint has no subscription check (correct design - badge available to all users)
Coach Panel maintains existing functionality with coach list showing name, role, email, phone, and edit/delete actions
seed_data_creation: Inserted and removed test coach_watch_alert for UCLA to verify amber badge state
context_for_next_testing_agent: Coach Watch badge feature complete. Test user pro@test.com has UCLA (prog_4cc20b4d04f9) with 1 coach (Mike Rodriguez). The /api/ai/coach-watch/alert/{university_name} endpoint is available to all users (no subscription check) while /api/ai/coach-watch/alerts requires Premium tier.

journey_page_loads.details: Journey page loads at /journey/prog_4cc20b4d04f9 with Coach Panel visible in right sidebar

staff_stable_badge_green.details: When no alerts exist, badge shows 'Staff Stable' with green dot and emerald styling

staff_change_badge_amber.details: When alert exists, badge shows 'Staff Change' with amber dot and amber/yellow styling

alert_detail_box.details: Alert detail box appears below badge showing alert type (Staff change detected), summary text, and detection date

backend_api_individual_alert.details: GET /api/ai/coach-watch/alert/{university_name} returns alert data or null correctly

coach_panel_coach_info.details: Coach Panel shows coach name, role, email, phone for Mike Rodriguez (Head Coach)

add_coach_button.details: Add coach (+) button visible next to badge, opens CoachForm with all fields (name, role, email, phone, save/cancel)
